theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.ocneanuFamily_finrank_le {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (S : Finset YoungDiagram) (hcard : ∀ mu ∈ S, mu.card = n) (hne : ∀ mu ∈ S, 0 < mu.rowLen 0) :
Module.finrank R ↥(Submodule.span R (Set.range fun (z : R) (mu : { x : YoungDiagram // x ∈ S }) => Polynomial.eval z (ocneanuNumPoly q ↑mu))) ≤ n

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.ocneanuNumPoly_eval {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q z : R) (mu : YoungDiagram) :
Polynomial.eval z (ocneanuNumPoly q mu) = ∏ c ∈ mu.cells, (q ^ (2 * c.1) * (q ^ 2 - 1 - q * z) + q ^ (2 * c.2 + 1) * z)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.ocneanuNum_diagonal_split {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q z : R) (mu : YoungDiagram) :
∏ c ∈ mu.cells, (q ^ (2 * c.1) * (q ^ 2 - 1 - q * z) + q ^ (2 * c.2 + 1) * z) = (∏ c ∈ mu.cells with c.1 = c.2, q ^ (2 * c.1) * (q ^ 2 - 1)) * ∏ c ∈ mu.cells with ¬c.1 = c.2, (q ^ (2 * c.1) * (q ^ 2 - 1) + (q ^ (2 * c.2 + 1) - q ^ (2 * c.1 + 1)) * z)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.ocneanuNumFactor_diagonal_z_free {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q z : R) (i : ℕ) :
q ^ (2 * i) * (q ^ 2 - 1 - q * z) + q ^ (2 * i + 1) * z = q ^ (2 * i) * (q ^ 2 - 1)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.ocneanuNumFactor_affine {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q z : R) (i j : ℕ) :
q ^ (2 * i) * (q ^ 2 - 1 - q * z) + q ^ (2 * j + 1) * z = q ^ (2 * i) * (q ^ 2 - 1) + (q ^ (2 * j + 1) - q ^ (2 * i + 1)) * z

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.ocneanuNumFactor_eq_zero_of_content_neg_two {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) (hq : q ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0) (j : ℕ) :
q ^ (2 * (j + 2)) * (q ^ 2 - 1 - q * (q ^ 3 / (q ^ 2 + 1))) + q ^ (2 * j + 1) * (q ^ 3 / (q ^ 2 + 1)) = 0
